    *   Open the gate: Noxious stimuli, fatigue of alpha-beta fibers, anxiety, stress, pain from other sources, etc.
    *   Close the gate: Non-noxious stimuli (touch, vibration, licking), electrical stimulation (TENS), relaxation, focus on distractions.
